Careers at Aurora

We’re solving user management once and for all.

See open positions

The team

Join a global team dedicated to their craft

We work with incredible talent from all around the world, each offering unique skills and perspectives. Joining Aurora means you’ll collaborate with industry leaders, learn from the best, and continuously grow.

Year founded
2019
Total funding
$105M
Team
~100
Companies served
15K+

Perks and benefits

Bring your ideas and passion, and we’ll offer you flexibility, growth, and a team that cares.

See open positions

Competitive salary

We want you to know that we value the skills you bring to the table, so we go out of our way to make sure you’re fairly compensated.

Equity ownership

At Aurora, we believe in shared success, which is why we offer a stock option plan that everyone stands to benefit from as we grow.

Health coverage

We care about your well-being, so we offer top-tier health insurance to ensure your health needs are met. (US-based employees)

Work equipment

We’ll make sure you have everything you need to set up your ideal home office with the gear of your choice.

Flexible vacation policy

We’re believers in work-life balance and trust you to take the time you need with our unlimited vacation policy.

Remote and diverse team

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where you can do the best work of your life with a global, fully-remote team.

Benefits may vary by country. Benefits listed above currently apply to our US based employees.

Open roles

Join a team where you can be you, make an impact, and thrive, without compromise.

Don’t see your dream role? We’re always looking for Staff+ engineers across the stack. Let’s chat about how you can make your mark with us!

Join our team
